header.description: Clinical Header with Brand logo, HuggingFace model badge, status pulse, and Quick Sample loader

tabs.description: Record Mic vs Upload Audio tab selector with high contrast active state and keyboard navigation

upload_zone.description: Drag and drop zone accepting WAV, MP3, M4A, WebM up to 25MB, with animated drop outline and file spec callout

recorder_zone.description: Microphone recorder with real-time Web Audio API frequency visualizer, timer, pause/stop controls, and browser permission handling

audio_player_preview.description: Pre-analysis playback bar with interactive waveform, time scrubbing, playback speed, and metadata pill (duration, format, 16kHz mono auto-conversion notice)

analyze_button.description: Primary CTA button triggering FastAPI HuggingFace inference with loading spinner & lazy-load warning

confidence_meter.description: Calibrated score meter showing confidence percentage, threshold markers (0-50% AI / 50-100% Human), and animated fill

result_badge.description: High-visibility status badge ('Likely Human' or 'AI-Generated') with color coding and icon indicator

disclaimer_card.description: Clinical notice emphasizing that classification is probabilistic AI estimation and not forensic legal proof

model_status_toast.description: Alert banner explaining HuggingFace model lazy loading (~300MB download on first run) with friendly retry action if HF fails

image_urls.description: Blue sound wave graphic asset for preview banner background
Spectrum visual asset for clinical audio analysis hero illustration

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all interactive elements have explicit data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='upload-input', data-testid='record-mic-button', data-testid='analyze-button').
Integrate HuggingFace model lazy-loading state gracefully in UI with a friendly downloading indicator and clear retry button if connection drops.
Implement Web Audio API for recording microphone input and rendering real-time waveform visualization.
Display audio duration up to 60 seconds (highlighting if audio is truncated to first 60 seconds).
Show a clear, high-contrast Confidence Meter with % score, verdict badge ('Likely Human' vs 'AI-Generated'), and prominent probabilistic legal disclaimer.
Support preset sample audio files (e.g., Human Sample, Synthetic AI Sample) for immediate 1-click testing.
Ensure files are immediately purged after analysis and display a 'Temporary File Purged' privacy badge.
Use Lucide React or Phosphor icons for medical/audio verification icons (Mic, Upload, ShieldCheck, Sparkles, AlertCircle, RefreshCw, FileAudio).

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.testing_attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case format.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.spacing: Use generous padding (p-6, p-8) and spacing (gap-6, gap-8) to prevent text collision and maintain a clean clinical feel.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.theme_rules: Light theme background with ultra-crisp slate borders (#E2E8F0) and subtle glassmorphism cards. High contrast text (#0F172A).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.color_discipline: Reserve Emerald (#059669) exclusively for Likely Human verdicts, Rose (#E11D48) for AI-Generated verdicts, and Sky Blue (#0284C7) for interactive CTAs.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.no_emoji_icons: Do NOT use AI assistant emoji characters (🤖, 🧠, 💡) for UI icons. Use Lucide SVG icons exclusively.
